text:
Sapporo Station has coin lockers
that turn free in a disaster. 🧳

Since July 2025, JR Sapporo has had
"disaster-response" lockers.
If people must evacuate, you can lock your bags
away at no cost and leave with empty hands.

Did you know Japan had these? 👇
